messages:
ada: Quick heads-up — postdeploy smoke running in us-west-2 after the 2026.03.17-rc3 rollout. deploy-bot shows success but our mini-synth reports intermittent 504s from proxy-2. Anyone seeing this?

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout finished service=proxy target_pool=usw2-release version=2026.03.17-rc3 duration=5m status=ok
sam: Confirming, reproduced 504s on proxy-2 — 3/10 samples returned 504 within the first minute. Sample: ```curl -s -D - https://usw2-api.redwood.ai/health -o /dev/null
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out```
bryan: Checking envoy and upstream traces now. Quick Q: was proxy-2 a newly launched instance during this rollout?
ada: Yes, proxy-2 was replaced (new AMI) as part of the batch.
kelly: Telemetry shows a spike in backend grpc timeouts aimed at model-serving pods behind proxy-2, and connection pool exhaustion on that host.
sam: We can bump backend timeouts but that just masks pool exhaustion. Suggest routing traffic off proxy-2 (partial pin) and run a warm prefill + restart on that host.
bryan: +1. Propose: route 25% traffic away from proxy-2 immediately, run warmup (50 small requests), then restart the proxy process. If 504s stop, we can gradually shift traffic back.
ada: Need a decision: temporary routing or full rollback of infra change? Model variant pinning not needed (no model diffs).
kelly: Do NOT rollback model variant — sounds infra-level. Route off proxy-2, restart, and run kvcache prefill. If that doesn't clear errors, roll back the instance (restore previous ASG image set).
deploy-bot: Incident created incident-2026-03-17-1739512345 severity=low paging=@sam oncall. Actions logged to incident.
sam: Taking oncall. Kicking restart of proxy-2 now and starting kv-prefill (small batch of warm requests). ETA ~2m for restart + 5m warmup.
sam: Restart completed. Quick checks: 504s dropped to 0 in the last 30s, p95 latency returned to baseline (~120ms). Continuing warmup for a few minutes to stabilize caches.
kelly: Leaving a follow-up: add a pre-rollout synthetic that verifies grpc connection pooling after AMI swaps. Will file short RFC.
bryan: I'll open a runbook PR adding: (1) route-off flow, (2) kv-prefill step, (3) automatic routing rollback if 5xx > 1% for 2m.
ada: Thanks all. Marking as resolved for now unless errors reappear. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: CI job #4521 triggered by bryan to update runbook and add synthetic test — job queued.
ada: noted, closing thread unless we see recurrence.
